def format_currency_symbol(amount, symbol):
    negative = amount < 0
    total_cents = round(abs(amount) * 100)
    whole, cents = divmod(total_cents, 100)
    digits = str(whole)
    groups = []
    while len(digits) > 3:
        groups.insert(0, digits[-3:])
        digits = digits[:-3]
    groups.insert(0, digits)
    grouped = ','.join(groups)
    body = f"{symbol}{grouped}.{cents:02d}"
    return ('-' + body) if negative else body
